title: Which way does your bow lie?
hook: Which wrap pattern tends to hold better?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Opposing knot stages make the balanced slipped reef bow sit across the shoe. The granny bow tends to turn along it; impact and moving lace ends can work a bow loose.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.
objective: Opposing knot stages make the balanced slipped reef bow sit across the shoe. The granny bow tends to turn along it; impact and moving lace ends can work a bow loose.
